main_body: Market stall: a striped green/cream awning on top, a produce shelf in the middle, and a wooden counter with a front panel and stone base below.
top_band: Counter top: light orange-brown highlight at row 26 (L=131), then mid-brown rows 27-29 (L=98), about 4 rows. It sits below the shelf and awning and is separated from the front face by a step of 35-50 L.
evidence: In column x=16, rows 26-29 form a lighter counter surface with produce standing on it. Rows 30-40 are the darker vertical front face, with a centre split and darker panel borders. The awning has a dark underside and shadow at rows 11-13. This matches the reference stall construction, where a lighter top band sits above the front face. The counter top is foreshortened and only moderately deep, but it reads as a horizontal surface.

style.evidence: The candidate has 20 colours per tile against 17 and 20 for the references, and 37 distinct colours against 40 and 38. Flat-fill coverage is 13%, the same as the cheese stall. Only 1% of dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outlines lean brown or green and follow the adjacent material. The awning has 3-4 greens plus cream, and the wood has several browns with grain and highlights. Overall it is as rich as the stall reference.
